def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Number_of_Reports_by_Type.csv', header=0)
    df.columns = ['Year', 'Fraud', 'Identity Theft', 'Other']
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Year'])
    df['Identity Theft'] = df['Identity Theft'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    return df

operators.customDisplayName: Load CSN reports data from 2024_CSN_Number_of_Reports_by_Type.csv with correct headers, parse Year as numeric, and parse Identity Theft column by removing commas and converting to int. Filter out null rows and metadata rows.
Calculate the ratio of Identity Theft reports in 2024 vs 2001. Filters data for years 2024 and 2001, computes the ratio, and rounds to 4 decimal places.
